verses.html: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David. Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David. Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.title: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.text: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

verses.html: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
verses.text: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

verses.html: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.text: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

verses.html: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
verses.text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

verses.html: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.text: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

verses.html: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
verses.text: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

verses.html: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
